reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the single-phase solid-solution constraint by proposing an in-situ precipitation intervention within the Ti-Ni HEA, with a physically sound mechanism (coherent precipitate pinning) and a specific, testable design including clear conditions, baseline, and falsification experiment. Hypothesis B violates the single-phase requirement by introducing an external oxide dispersoid, relies on a less specific mechanism (severe lattice distortion), and cites evidence from different alloy systems and conditions that do not directly support the proposed Ti-Ni HEA regime.
